Rottcodd is a character in one of my favorite novels - Titus Groan by Mervyn Peake.

He's the curator of The Hall of Bright Carvings - a sculpture gallery high in a distant corner of the castle in which the novel is set. His duty as the curator is to keep the statues clean, and that's exactly what he does. He meticulously dusts every statue every day. That's all he does though - the hall itself is ankle-deep in accumulated dust. When he's discharged his duty, he either sleeps or watches through his window and tries to work out what's going on in the castle far below him. His analyses regarding what's going on are surprisingly accurate, but he doesn't know that, since nobody ever comes to the Hall.

I just like, and identify with, the character.
